decision.instructions: Use motion_limits.acceleration_response: measured_0_50kn is nominal straight acceleration to a 50-knot target, not maximum capability; bounded and other maneuvers use physical limits. Reach the current waypoint circle. Respect speed limits. Physical acceleration/braking and angular acceleration are bounded: brake early; target course is not reached instantly. Avoid reversing an ongoing turn. Choose a maneuver on target_turn_side; straight when ahead. Prefer smaller target heading error, then smaller forecast distance and less turning. Keep straight when aligned. A target behind the boat may require turning while distance initially increases; avoid repeated reversals.
